comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar against a measured table: a MARRIED dependent who files a joint return with their spouse, is not required to file it, and files it only to claim a refund PASSES the joint-return test (IRC 152(b)(2)) and is claimed. Every served line equals wages-and-child-single's to the cent — the 2,200 child tax credit between lines 16 and 24 (3,665 - 2,200 = 1,465) and the 345 earned income credit in line 33 (6,000 + 345 = 6,345) — which is what makes its counterfactual, wages-and-married-child-joint-single, a claim DENIED rather than a different return. Earlier, this row was refused before the engine saw it.
